title: Number of Connected Components In An Undirected Graph
kidExplanation: Story version: This problem can be solved using Depth-First Search (DFS) or Breadth-First Search (BFS). We represent the given edges as an adjacency list, where each node points to its neighboring nodes. We then iterate through all nodes and perform a DFS/BFS from each unvisited node to explore all connected components. The number of times we need to start a new DFS/BFS corresponds to the number of connected components in the graph. (We will slow down and draw it.)
